meta.title: Hestia
meta.description: Nemo kauyukan da ba a taswira ba da kuma kai musu tawagar rigakafin cutar.

home.lead: A halin yanzu, sama da mutane biliyan 1.9 ba su da damar kiwon lafiya, kawai saboda inda suke zaune.
home.mapLead: Batun kula da lafiyar karkara a duniya ya samo asali ne daga dalilai guda 3: 1) Gwamnatoci ba su san inda mutane suke zaune ba, 2) Gwamnatoci ba su san hanyar da ta fi dacewa ta kai su ba, da 3) Gwamnatoci ba su san nawa za a kashe don taimakawa ba. Kowane ɗayan waɗannan batutuwan sun fito ne daga ƙarancin bayanai, bayanan da muke samarwa yanzu ta hanyar hangen nesa na kwamfuta akan tauraron dan adam da bayanan OpenStreetMap. Danna cikin wata ƙasa don ganin bincikenmu tare da duk bayanansu.

problem.title: Matsala
problem.subtitle: A duk duniya, mutane biliyan 1.9 ba su da damar kiwon lafiya kawai saboda suna zaune a yankunan karkara na kasarsu.
problem.locationBody1: Yawancin taswirori na hukuma da gwamnatoci ke amfani da su don ba da bayanai ga cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya sun ɓace yawancin ƙauyuka. Wannan ya zama ruwan dare a kasashe masu tasowa. Ba tare da taswirorin sun san inda waɗannan mutane suke ba, hanyar da za a iya gano su ita ce ta amfani da tauraron dan adam.
problem.locationBody2: An tabbatar da hakan a fili a cikin 2025, lokacin da wani binciken kimiyya ya kwatanta taswirar yawan jama'a biyar da suka fi shahara da kididdigar rayuwa a yankunan karkara na duniya. Babu ɗayansu da ke kusa da ainihin amsar. Maimakon haka, duk sun raina cikkaken al’ummar yankin. Mafi kyawun taswira, WorldPop, shine kawai kashi 47% na yawan mutanen yankin.
problem.mapCaption: Taswirori na waje sukan ɓoye ƙauyuka waɗanda za mu iya samu ta hanyar hotunan tauraron dan adam
problem.undercountCaption: Nawa ne kowane taswirar yawan jama'a ba a ƙidaya mazauna karkara ba, akan matsakaita (1975-2010)
problem.routesTitle: Asibitoci ba su san hanya mafi arha don isa gare su ba
problem.routesBody1: Ko da gwamnati ta san inda kauyukan suke, har yanzu ba su san hanyar da ta fi dacewa ta kai su ba.
problem.routesBody2: Tare da yawancin asibitocin kiwon lafiya suna cikin birane ko garuruwa, yana iya zama da wahala sosai a gano asibitin da ya kamata ya yi ƙoƙarin isa ƙauyuka mafi kusa.
problem.routesBody3: Tare da batun wace asibitin zai yi kokarin isa kauyen, akwai kuma batun yadda za su yi shirin isa wurin, saboda mafi karancin hanya ba sau da yawa ba ne mafi arha. Don warware wani abu makamancin haka, asibitin kiwon lafiya zai buƙaci wata hanya don ci gaba da auna terrians daban-daban a kan hanyoyi.
problem.travelCaption: A cikin kowane mutum 100 na duniya, nawa kowannensu yake da nisa daga cibiyar kiwon lafiya mafi kusa
problem.byCar: Fiye da awa daya ya rage, har da mota
problem.onFoot: Ana iya isa ta mota, amma tafiya fiye da awa ɗaya
problem.routeCaption: Hanya mafi guntu akan taswira ba koyaushe shine mafi arha ba
problem.fundingTitle: Asibitocin karkara ba sa samun isassun kudi
problem.fundingBody1: Domin raba kudaden tsakanin cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya daban-daban, dole ne a san farashin tafiye-tafiye da adadin mutanen da aka ziyarta daidai. Dangane da kayan aikin karkara, ba a san kowane ɗayan waɗannan dabi'un ba (saboda batutuwa 1 da 2). Idan ba tare da su ba, gwamnatoci ba su san adadin kuɗin da za su ba kowane ginin ba, wanda ke iyakance adadin abin da za su iya yi.
problem.fundingBody2: Hakan ya faru ne saboda abin da ke faruwa idan ba a yi wa gwamnati ƙayyadadden ƙiyasin farashi ba. Ba tare da sanin hakikanin kudin da ake kashewa wajen yi wa jama’arsu hidima ba, gwamnatoci sun damu da yin sama da fadi da dukiyar da za a iya amfani da su a wasu wurare. Yayin da wuce gona da iri ya zama babban tunani a cikin zukatansu, sakamakon kusan ko da yaushe yana raguwa, wanda zai iya haifar da tsare-tsare masu ban mamaki ba a cika su ba.
problem.chainCaption: Yadda wani ƙauye ya ɓace yana asarar kuɗin sa
problem.chain1Text: Tauraron dan adam na iya ganin rufin, amma taswirar hukuma babu kowa.
problem.chain2Text: Kiyasin yawan jama'a ya bar mutane.
problem.chain3Title: Ba a cikin kasafin kudin ba
problem.chain3Text: Ana raba kuɗi ta hanyar ƙididdigewa, don haka babu wanda aka keɓe a gefe.
problem.chain4Text: Asibitin mafi kusa yana da ƙarancin ma'aikata, alluran rigakafi da mai.
problem.costChainCaption: Yadda kiyasin farashin da ya ɓace ke kaiwa ga rashin kashe kuɗi
problem.cost1Text: Babu wanda ya san abin da ma'aikata, man fetur da tafiya zuwa kowane ƙauye zai biya.
problem.cost2Text: Masu tsarawa dole ne su yi hasashen adadin isar da saƙon ƙauyuka ke buƙata.
problem.cost3Text: Gudun kuɗaɗen shiga tsakani yana da haɗari, don haka suna tsammani ƙananan.
problem.cost4Text: Ana yanke tafiye-tafiye, kuma an fara jefa ƙauyuka masu nisa.

diagrams.mapGapLabel: A kan taswirar hukuma yankin yana nuna hanya ɗaya da gari ɗaya mai asibiti. Kallon tauraron dan adam na wannan yanki ya nuna wasu kauyuka guda hudu da taswirar ta bari.
diagrams.routeDiagramLabel: Asibitoci guda uku zasu iya kaiwa ga sulhu. Tafiya mafi arha tana bin hanyar da aka shimfida, sannan hanyar datti, sannan gajeriyar shimfida babu hanya.
diagrams.tourLabel: Tawagar daya ta bar asibitin, ta ziyarci kauyuka shida ta dawo. Madaidaicin madauki yana ziyartar ƙauye mafi arha a kowane lokaci kuma ya ketare kanta; madauki mai haske shine ƙauyuka iri ɗaya a cikin tsari mai rahusa.

solution.title: Magani
solution.subtitle: Nemo matsuguni, hanya, da farashi.
solution.findTitle: Tauraron dan adam sun gano taswirorin rufin da aka manta
solution.findBody1: Wani bincike a cikin 2025 ya nuna cewa mafi kyawun taswirar yawan jama'a a duniya a yau har yanzu sun rasa fiye da rabin yawan mutanen da ke yankunan karkara da suke rufewa. Madadin haka, Hestia tana amfani da hotunan tauraron dan adam don gano ƙauyuka waɗanda waɗancan taswirar yawan jama'a suka ɓace.
solution.findBody2: Hestia yana amfani da bayanan fa'idar ginin Microsoft azaman hanyar wucewa ta farko akan yanki. Ƙara koyo game da yadda ake haɗa su a cikin shafin Algorithm.
solution.findBody3: Lokacin da Microsoft ba shi da bayanai don dubawa, Hestia tana zazzage hotuna daga Esri World Imagery Wayback, wanda hotunansa muke gudanar da algorithm na al'ada.
solution.stepsCaption: Daga tauraron dan adam zuwa zama
solution.step1Text: Microsoft yana zayyanawa ta tsohuwa, amma yana yin amfani da tauraron dan adam ba tare da shi ba.
solution.step2Text: Kowane gini ana zana shi akan grid don cire komai sai gidajen.
solution.step3Text: Gine-gine na kusa an haɗa su zuwa wani yanki.
solution.step4Text: Don nunawa, muna zayyana su don sauƙaƙe gani.
solution.factGapLabel: mafi girman tazara tsakanin gine-gine a cikin yanki ɗaya
solution.factHomeLabel: mutane a gida (matsakaicin gida a Najeriya)
solution.checkTitle: Yawancin ƙauyukan Hestia ba a tsara su ba
solution.checkBody1: Tabbas, Hestia tana kwatanta sakamakonta tare da OpenStreetMap don bincika gidajen makwabta, yana fitar da tabbataccen maki 100.
solution.checkBody2: Idan OpenStreetMap bai dawo da komai a kusa ba, zamu iyakance tabbacinmu zuwa 99 kuma muyi amfani da alamun sasantawa guda uku don gina wannan ƙimar. Ƙididdiga na gini, ƙaranci, da murfin ginin (yawan jimillar da ke kama da rufin).
solution.matchCaption: Rarraba binciken mu ta ko OpenStreetMap ya dawo gida kusa.
solution.scoreCaption: Buga madaidaicin OpenStreetMap bai sani ba game da (0-99)
solution.scoreCoverDetail: Cikakken maki a 15% na faci (35% pixels rufin tare da madadin launi)
solution.scoreFootnote: Wannan yana ƙara har zuwa maki {total}. Makin yana tsayawa a 99, saboda kawai wasan OpenStreetMap zai iya kaiwa 100.
solution.reachTitle: Nemo hanya mafi arha daga asibiti
solution.reachBody1: Ta hanyar OpenStreetMap, Hestia ya sami nau'ikan cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya daban-daban a cikin radius kilomita 40 na binciken ta tsohuwa, amma idan ba a sami komai ba, yankin binciken yana ƙaruwa zuwa kilomita 660. Bayan gano wurin yana gina taswirar duk hanyoyin da abin hawa zai iya bi (yana tsallake wannan idan ba a sami wurin ba).
solution.reachBody2: Hestia ta sami kuɗin tafiya daga wuraren kiwon lafiya uku mafi kusa da aka samu kusa da kowane ƙauye kuma yana adana mafi ƙarancin tsada. Daban-daban na hanya suna da farashi daban-daban.
solution.reachBody3: Baya ga farashi, kowace tafiya ana ba da maki mai wahala, kiyaye yanayin ƙasa da lokacin da ake buƙata don yin balaguron.
solution.routeCaption: Hestia yana gwada dakunan shan magani guda uku mafi kusa kuma yana kiyaye tafiya mafi arha
solution.rateCaption: Kudin tafiya a kowace kilomita, ta hanyar OpenStreetMap (US$)
solution.rateNote: Hanyoyin da galibi ake shimfida su sun fi sau 1.5 idan OpenStreetMap ta ce datti ne, tsakuwa ko yashi. Mun zaɓi waɗannan ƙimar don tsarawa. Har yanzu ba a auna su a filin ba.
solution.tourBody1: Yin makirci da bin hanya zuwa kowane yanki yana nufin ƙungiyar lafiya za ta buƙaci wucewa iri ɗaya sau da yawa. Don magance wannan, Hestia ya shirya balaguro zuwa duk ƙauyuka (tare da ƙima mai yawa) a cikin dubawa don ƙungiyar lafiya ta iya rage farashi.
solution.tourBody2: Ana sake tsara hanyar asibiti a duk lokacin da aka ajiye sabon sikanin don tabbatar da cewa yana da kyau kamar yadda za mu iya yi.
solution.diagramCaption: Tawaga ɗaya, madauki ɗaya daga asibiti da baya

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.subtitle: Matakai bakwai. Algorithm mai haɓakawa ɗaya.
algorithm.seeLines: Duba waɗannan layin a cikin lambar
algorithm.sourceLead: Anan ga lambar ganowa kowane binciken yana gudana (an yi sharhi) (detect-villages.js akan layin umarni yana kiransa). Bude mataki na sama don tsalle zuwa wancan ɓangaren, ko zazzage duk fayil ɗin don amfani!
algorithm.scanSource: Kowane scan yana gudanar da wannan fayil ɗin. Taimaka mana bincika yanki!
algorithm.readError: detect-villages.js ba za a iya karantawa ba.
algorithm.pictureText: Da farko muna zazzage jigon kowane gini a cikin ƙaramin akwati daga taswirar ginin duniya na Microsoft.
algorithm.pictureDetail: An gina taswirar ginin Microsoft na duniya akan samfurin AI wanda aka horar da tauraron dan adam na duniya baki daya. Binciken yana kusan kilomita 4 zuwa 4 kuma muna ajiye gine-ginen da cibiyarsu ke cikin akwatin.
algorithm.roofsTitle: Shirin Ajiyayyen: nemo rufin ta launi
algorithm.roofsText: Wasu wuraren Microsoft ba su da wani bayanai, don haka a can muke neman rufin asiri a cikin hotunan tauraron dan adam da kanmu.
algorithm.roofsDetail: Mun ware bishiyoyi, ruwa da inuwa. Kodadden ƙarfe da ƙarfe mai shuɗi ana ƙidaya su azaman rufi ne, yayin da ja, koɗi da launin toka mai lebur kawai suna ƙidayar idan akwai kaifi mai kaifi. Kasa ja, dattin hanyoyi da kwalta launuka iri daya ne kuma gefunansu suna shudewa a hankali, don haka su ma ba a cire su.
algorithm.joinText: Gine-ginen da ke cikin kusan mita 50 na juna suna shiga cikin yanki ɗaya, sa'an nan kuma mu ƙirƙira raga sannan kuma polygon a kusa da ƙungiyar.
algorithm.joinDetail: Muna zana kowane gine-gine a kan grid na mita 3, cika rata tsakanin waɗanda ke kusa da kuma gano kowane rukuni. Gida daya da kansa har yanzu yana lissafin zama. Idan ƙungiya ce kawai ƙananan rumfa da granaries za mu sauke ta ko da yake, saboda babu wanda ke zaune a cikin waɗannan.
algorithm.checkTitle: Bincika idan ya riga ya kasance akan taswira
algorithm.checkText: Idan OpenStreetMap yana da ƙauye, ƙauye, gari, yanki ko wurin zama na kaɗaici a cikin jigon ko tsakanin mita 150, muna kiran shi wasa 100%, koda ba tare da sunan saiti ba.
algorithm.checkDetail: Lokacin da taswirar ba ta da wani abu a wurin, muna ƙididdige madaidaicin daga 99: maki 45 don yawan gine-ginen da yake da shi (cikakken a 8), 30 don ƙaƙƙarfansa da 25 na nawa gine-gine ne. Wuraren da ke kan taswirar kawai suna samun 100. Lambobin anan shine sigar madadin launi, inda cikakkun alamomin wannan ɓangaren na ƙarshe yana nufin 35% na jita-jita yayi kama da rufin. Tare da ƙayyadaddun bayanan Microsoft ana amfani da ma'aunin nauyi iri ɗaya a ƙasan fayil ɗin, kuma cikakkun alamun akwai kashi 15% na jita-jita da gine-gine suka rufe.
algorithm.costText: Muna ƙidayar yawan jama'a a matsayin mutum 4.7 a kowace gida (matsakaicin Najeriya), ta yin amfani da matsakaicin adadin mutane kowane gida a yankin. Ana ƙidaya alluran rigakafin a matsayin $10 mutum kuma ziyarar kanta wani $100 ne.
algorithm.costDetail: Duk wani abu da ke ƙasa da murabba'in murabba'in 10 mai yiwuwa rumbun ajiya ne ko zubar, don haka ba za mu ƙidaya shi ba. Gida na yau da kullun gida ɗaya ne, kuma babban ginin gaske yana ƙidaya a matsayin gida ɗaya na kowane murabba'in murabba'in mita 150. Tare da ajiyar launi ba za mu iya auna gine-gine ba, don haka muna ƙidaya mutane 5 akan rufin ko 5 a cikin murabba'in murabba'in mita 250, ko wanne ya fi, kuma ba kasa da 5 ba.
algorithm.tripText: Koma menene, muna ci gaba da duba wuraren da ke kusa har sai mun sami asibiti. Sannan muna farashin tafiye-tafiye daga asibitocin da ke kusa, muna duba asibitocin da ke kusa da mafi kusa don tafiya mafi arha, ba mafi kusa ba.
algorithm.tripDetail: An fara binciken ne daga kimanin kilomita 40 kuma ana gudanar da bincike kadan zuwa kusan 660. Idan har yanzu babu asibitin da ya yi nisa, ana farashin tafiyar kilomita 660 ba tare da hanya ba kuma babu asibitin. Titunan da aka shimfida gabaɗaya sune mafi arha a kowace kilomita, yayin da waƙoƙin suna da tsada kuma ko'ina ba tare da hanya ba. Idan asibitin yana da nisa da gaske, muna ba da fifiko ta amfani da manyan tituna don yawancin tuƙi.
algorithm.tourText: Tawaga ɗaya ta bar asibitin, ta tsaya a kowane yanki kuma ta dawo, a kowane tsari mafi arha. Kowace tafiya ya dogara da asibitin da aka raba, ba kawai yankin ba, yana ba mu hanya mafi kyau don kowane tafiya.
algorithm.tourDetail: Tafiyar ta fara ne a asibitin da aka fi sani da leka. Idan babu asibitin, yana farawa ne a wurin da ke kusa da hanya. Da farko yana ci gaba da zuwa mafi arha tasha wanda ya rage. Sa'an nan kuma mu duba tafiya ta hanyar tsinkaya madadin hanyar, idan an jujjuya madauki, sannan zaɓi mafita mafi arha. An shirya tafiye-tafiyen asibiti a kashe sauran sikanin da nasa. Ƙarƙashin ƙaƙƙarfan ƙaƙƙarfan ƙauyuka an tsallake (<30 tabbas).

scenes.pictureNote: Ƙididdigar gine-gine suna ɗaukar murabba'i ɗaya a lokaci guda kuma a yanke su don dacewa da akwatin.
scenes.keepLabel: Abin da za a kiyaye daga hoton
scenes.roofsKept: Bishiyoyi, ruwa, inuwa da hanya sun tafi. Jan tayal, siminti da rufin ƙarfe suna tsayawa.
scenes.roofsAll: Wannan shine hoton tauraron dan adam kafin a cire komai.
scenes.joinLabel: Rufaffiyar da ke kusa sun haɗa cikin zane ɗaya. An jefar da wani wuri guda ɗaya.
scenes.joinNote: Gine-ginen da ke tsakanin kimanin mita 50 na juna sun zama wuri guda. Zubar da kanta ake cirewa.
scenes.mappedLabel: Ko OpenStreetMap ya riga ya sami wannan wurin
scenes.certaintyMapped: Tabbas. Wurin da aka tsara ya tabbatar da ƙauyen.
scenes.certaintyAlone: Tabbatacce daga gine-gine kadai. Ba zai iya kaiwa 100 ba.
scenes.checkExample: Wannan misalin yana da gine-gine 6, ƙaƙƙarfan 0.36, da gine-ginen da ke rufe 11% na shaci.
scenes.costNote: Gwada matsar da darjewa. Ziyarar har yanzu tana kashe dala 100 koda kuwa sulhun yana da kankanta.
scenes.notePrimary: Clinic A shine mafi nisa. Hanyar an shimfida ko da yake, don haka ita ce tafiya mafi arha kuma Hestia ta ɗauka.
scenes.noteTrack: Waƙar ya fi guntu. Kudinsa ya kai dala 4.50 a kowace kilomita, don haka kudin tafiyar ya fi na titin da aka shimfida.
scenes.noteNone: kilomita 3 ne kacal. Babu wata hanya ko da yake, don haka ƙungiyar tana tafiya a hankali kuma kowane kilomita yana kashe $ 8.
scenes.noteGreedy: Zuwa ƙauyen da ke da arha don isa gaba kowane lokaci kamar zai yi aiki. Sai hanyar ta koma yadda ta zo ta haye kanta.
scenes.noteImproved: 2-opt yana jujjuya sassan madauki idan hakan ya sa ya zama mai arha, kuma yana tsayawa lokacin da babu wani taimako. Waɗannan ƙauyuka ɗaya ne waɗanda ba su da tsallaka.

donate.title: Taimaka samun alluran rigakafi zuwa ƙauyukan da ba su kan taswira
donate.lead: Yawancin ƙauyukan karkara ba sa kan taswirori na hukuma, kuma idan ba a cikin taswirar ƙauye to babu wanda zai tsara hanya a wurin. Don haka mutanen da ke zaune a wurin ba sa samun rigakafi. Lokacin da kuka ba da gudummawa, yana zuwa nemo waɗancan ƙauyuka da gano yadda ake zuwa wurinsu.
donate.scanChoose: Ba za a iya ba da gudummawa a yanzu? Kuna iya taimaka mana bincika yanki.
donate.needLead: Waɗannan su ne ainihin lambobi akan mutanen karkara, ɗaukar hoto da yara waɗanda ba su taɓa samun rigakafin ba.
donate.fact1Label: mutane suna zaune a yankunan karkara, kusan kashi 42% na yawan mutanen duniya.
donate.fact2Label: na mutanen karkara ba su da inshorar lafiya.
donate.fact3Label: mutanen karkara ba su da inshorar lafiya.
donate.fact4Label: Jarirai ba su sami allurar rigakafi ba a shekarar farko ta rayuwa a 2025.
donate.why1Title: Ƙauyen da ba a kan taswirar ba sun tsallake
donate.why1Text: Ma'aikatan lafiya za su iya zuwa inda suka san mutane suna zaune. Idan wani ƙauye bai taɓa sanya shi akan taswira ba, babu wanda zai taɓa tsara hanyar rigakafin a can.
donate.why2Title: Galibin mutanen karkara ba su da abin rufe fuska
donate.why2Text: ILO ta gano cewa kashi 56% na mutanen karkara ba su da wata inshorar lafiya. Haɗa wannan tare da mutanen karkara biliyan 3.46 na Bankin Duniya kuma za ku sami kusan biliyan 1.9.
donate.why3Title: Hanya tana gaya wa kuɗin inda za a je
donate.why3Text: Da zarar gwamnati za ta iya ganin ƙauye, da kuma yadda za ta isa can daga asibiti mafi kusa, a ƙarshe ta san inda kasafin lafiyarta ya kamata ya tafi.
donate.whereLead: Ka zaɓi wace gwamnati ce ke samun kyautarka. Muna amfani da shi don nemo ƙauyuka na karkara a wannan ƙasa waɗanda taswirar lafiya suka bari, sannan mu tsara hanyoyin rigakafin zuwa gare su.
donate.where1Text: Muna duba hotunan tauraron dan adam da bayanan taswira don matsuguni da taswirar kiwon lafiya da aka bari.
donate.where2Text: Hestia ya sami asibitin mafi kusa kuma yana aiki mafi kyawun hanya daga can zuwa ƙauyen.
donate.where3Text: Kyautar ku tana biyan alluran rigakafin da ma'aikatan lafiya waɗanda suka yi tafiya.
donate.chooseLead: A cikin waɗannan ƙasashe 25 da yawa mazauna karkara har yanzu ba su iya samun kulawar lafiya. Za mu tafi tare da na farko tunda yana da mafi yawan mutanen karkara a jerin.
donate.loadError: Ba za a iya loda alkaluman mutanen karkara na bankin duniya ba. Sake sabunta shafin don sake gwadawa.
donate.recommendedNote: Nasiha: {name}. Bankin Duniya ya kirga {rural} mutanen da ke zaune a yankunan karkara a can cikin {year}, fiye da kowace kasa a cikin wannan jerin.
donate.customAmount: Adadin kyauta na al'ada a cikin daloli
donate.impactReady: {amount} zai je {name}, inda {rural} mutane ke zaune a karkara (Bankin Duniya, {year}).
donate.impactContext: A cikin 2025, jarirai miliyan 13.5 a duniya ba su sami allurar rigakafi ko ɗaya ba a cikin shekararsu ta farko (WHO da UNICEF). Kyautar ku tana taimaka mana nemo ƙauyuka a cikin {name} waɗanda taswirorin hukuma suka ɓace kuma a ba su alluran rigakafi daga asibiti mafi kusa.

donate.payFine: Wannan ma'ajiya ce kawai a yanzu, ba zai caji katin ku ba.

explain.worldPopSummary: Kusan {people} mutanen karkara ba su da tsarin kiwon lafiya.
explain.worldPopNote: Yawan mutanen karkara shine kididdigar bankin duniya na baya-bayan nan ga kowace kasa. Kashi 56% shine adadin yankunan karkara na kungiyar kwadago ta duniya. An kiyasta wuraren da babu adadi na Bankin Duniya daga yankinsu.
explain.worldCostSummary: Menene kudin da za a kai da yi musu alluran rigakafi duka.
explain.worldCostNote: Ƙasar da ke da leken asiri tana amfani da kuɗin kowane mutum na binciken da aka samu. Kowace ƙasa tana amfani da matsakaicin matsakaici a duk sikanin.
explain.worldCountSummary: Kowace ƙasa akan taswira. {detected} a yi gwajin tauraron dan adam; sauran kiyasi ne kawai.
explain.worldDetectedSummary: Wuraren da muka bincika da gaske tare da hotunan tauraron dan adam.
explain.worldDetectedNote: Kowane sikanin yana rufe kusan kilomita 4 × 4. Ana samun matsuguni a hotunan tauraron dan adam kuma an duba su akan OpenStreetMap.

explain.countryPopArea: Bankin Duniya ba shi da adadi a nan, don haka ana kiyasin mazauna karkara daga fili.

explain.clinicTourNote: Ana sake shirya rangadin a duk lokacin da aka ajiye na'urar daukar hoto kusa da wannan asibitin, ta amfani da hanyoyi a duk inda yake da rahusa fiye da tafiya kai tsaye a cikin ƙasa.
explain.footprintSummary: Kimanin mutane {people}: {buildings} gine-gine suna yin {homes} gidaje × {per} mutane kowanne.
explain.footprintNote: Gine-ginen da ke ƙasa da {min} m² (granaries, rumna) ba gidaje ba ne. Gidan al'ada gida ɗaya ne; gini sama da {home} m² yana ƙidaya a matsayin gida ɗaya a kowace {home} m². {per} shine matsakaicin girman gida a Najeriya (DHS 2018).
explain.roofSummary: Kimanin mutane {people}: {roofs} rufin × {per} mutane a gida.
explain.sizeSummary: Kimanin mutane {people}, an kiyasta daga girman mazaunin.
explain.roofNote: Ana tsammanin kowane gida yana ɗaukar mutane {per}. Rufin da ya taɓa yana iya kama da ɗaya, don haka ana amfani da ƙimar girman (gida ɗaya a kowace {m2} m²) lokacin da ya fi girma.
explain.villageCostSummary: Yin rigakafin kowa a nan, da samun tawaga a nan.
explain.villageCostRoad: Alurar riga kafi shine {perPerson} akan kowane mutum da {perStop} don ziyarar. Tafiya yana bin hanyoyi inda zai yiwu ({low}–{high} kowace kilomita) kuma farashin {offroad} akan kowace kilomita daga kan hanya.
explain.villageCostNoClinic: Alurar riga kafi shine {perPerson} akan kowane mutum da {perStop} don ziyarar. Ba a sami asibiti a kusa ba, don haka ana farashin tafiye-tafiye a matsayin doguwar tafiya daga kan hanya.
explain.accessScale: Nisa daga hanya ya fi ƙidaya, sannan tsayin tafiya, sannan nawa hanyar ke da wahala. 0-33 yana da sauƙi, 34-66 matsakaici, 67-100 mai wuya.
explain.accessNoClinic: {label} ({score}/100): ba a sami wani asibiti a kusa ba, don haka duk tafiyar ta kirga a waje.
explain.osmConfirm: Babban: an jera wannan sulhu akan OpenStreetMap.
explain.osmConfirmNote: Wurin da aka tsara a cikin jigon, ko tsakanin {meters} m nasa, ya tabbatar da shi.
explain.confidenceFootprints: {level}: An tsara taswirar gine-ginenta, amma OpenStreetMap ba shi da sunan wurin (maki {score}/100).
explain.confidenceSatellite: {level}: ana samun shi kawai a cikin hotunan tauraron dan adam (maki {score}/100).
explain.confidenceFootprintNote: Ƙarin gine-gine, ƙaƙƙarfan siffa da ƙarin jita-jita da gine-gine ke rufe duk suna haɓaka maki (cikakken a gine-gine 8, kuma a {coverage} an rufe). Yana zama ƙasa da 100 sai dai idan OpenStreetMap ya sanya sunan wurin. Maɗaukaki shine 75+, Matsakaici 50-74, Ƙananan ƙasa da 50.
explain.confidenceColorNote: Ƙarin rufin, ƙaƙƙarfan siffa da ƙarin ƙasa mai launin rufin duk suna haɓaka maki. Yana zama ƙasa da 100 sai dai idan OpenStreetMap ya tabbatar da wurin. Maɗaukaki shine 75+, Matsakaici 50-74, Ƙananan ƙasa da 50.
explain.locationNote: Manna biyun cikin kowace taswira app don nemo shi. Hanyoyi da yawon shakatawa na tawagar sun isa a wannan lokacin.
explain.scanLocationNote: Kowane sikanin yana rufe akwatin kusan kilomita 4 × 4 a kusa da wannan batu. Manna biyun cikin kowace taswira app don nemo shi.
explain.noTour: Wannan sikanin bashi da ziyarar tawagar tukuna.
explain.skippedStop: Ba a kan yawon shakatawa na tawagar ba: amincewa yana da ƙasa ({score} / 100), don haka yana iya zama dandali maimakon gidaje.
explain.tourStopSummary: Tsaya {stop} na {stops} a zagayen tawagar daga {start}.
explain.tourStopNote: Oda shine wanda ke sanya jimlar kuɗin tafiya mafi ƙanƙanta.
explain.placeholderVillage: Majiɓinci: {name} rabon kiyasin yankinsa ne, ba wurin da aka gano ba.
